name: Bakobo OOBI Discovery Catalog
description: Generated inventory of every OOBI resource published at bakobo.com, grouped by type. GET /.well-known/oobi/<SAID>/index.json to resolve any one by SAID/AID without knowing its type. Discoverable via /.well-known/host-meta.json. Bakobo operates every witness listed here and also controls the AIDs they witness, so a receipt from this pool establishes that an event was witnessed and is being served -- it is evidence of availability, not of controller-accountability. A validator who needs protection against a controller colluding with its own witnesses must get it from a process under that validator's control, not from these receipts. Bakobo has incepted no organisational AIDs yet, so this catalog lists witnesses only; ACDC schemas are published separately at https://schema.bakobo.com/
